name: Camp Kweebec
description_short: Traditional coed overnight camp for ages 6 to 16 on 200 acres in the Perkiomen Valley, about an hour northwest of Philadelphia. Campers live in age divisions, with boys and girls on separate sides of camp, and do sports, arts and performance, two lakes and two pools, tennis, horseback riding, zip lines and ropes courses.
notes: 2027 fees after October 31: Full Season $13,250, First Half $9,250, Young Pilot Program $5,750 (before October 31 they were $12,250, $8,750 and $5,250); Explorer Weekend $350. No Second Half price on the page. Half Season and Pilot are only for a camper's first summer; Pilot is for new campers in grades 1 to 4. A $1,250 deposit per child, refundable until December 1, 2026 less a $500 processing fee. Alumni discounts available. Winter office: 26 Rock Hill Road, Bala Cynwyd, 610-667-2123.
